Definition: Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shebaniah = "increased by Jehovah"; 1) a Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 2) a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 3) a 2nd Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 4) a priest appointed by David to blow with the trumpets before the ark of God
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
